title: Privacy Policy
body:
MyMonthly (“we,” “our,” or “us”) values your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect your information when you use the MyMonthly iOS app (the “App”), including new features like Dual Partner Mode and expert content. By using the App, you agree to the practices described in this Policy.

1. Information We Collect

A. Information You Provide - We collect information you voluntarily provide when using the App, such as:
i. Account information (name, email, password)
ii. Menstrual and health tracking data
iii. Partner or connected user information (when using Dual Partner Mode)
iv. Messages, notes, or journal entries you create in the App

B. Information Collected Automatically - When you use the App, we may automatically collect:
i. Device information (model, operating system, device ID)
ii. Usage data (features used, app interactions, time spent)
iii. Analytics data to improve the App experience

C. Third-Party Information - We may receive information from third-party services if you choose to connect or link accounts (e.g., social login).

2. How We Use Your Information:
a. Provide, maintain, and improve the App and its features
b. Personalize your experience, including health insights and partner sharing
c. Send notifications or updates about the App
d. Analyze usage trends to improve UX/UI and content
e. Respond to your support requests or inquiries
f. Comply with legal obligations

3. Partner & Shared Data: In Dual Partner Mode, certain information you choose to share may become visible to the connected user. By using this feature, you consent to sharing your data in this way. You are responsible for managing what information you share. My Monthly is not liable for interpersonal outcomes arising from shared data.

4. Health & Expert Content Disclaimer: The App provides educational content, including articles and expert contributions. This content is for informational purposes only and is not medical advice. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical questions.

5. Data Sharing and Disclosure: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information in the following limited circumstances:
a. With service providers who perform services on our behalf (e.g., cloud storage, analytics)
b. For legal reasons: if required by law, regulation, or legal process
c. Business transfers: in the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets

6. Your Rights and Choices
a. Access and update your account information
b. Control what health or personal data is shared with a partner
c. Request deletion of your account and personal data (note: some data may remain for legal compliance)
d. Opt-out of marketing communications

7. Data Retention: We retain your information only as long as necessary to provide the App’s services or as required by law. When data is no longer needed, we securely delete or anonymize it.

8. Security: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, disclosure, or loss. However, no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

9. Third-Party Links: The App may include links to third-party websites or services. MyMonthly is not responsible for the privacy practices or content of these third parties.

10. Children’s Privacy: The App is intended for users 18 years or older. If you are under 18, you may only use the App with the explicit consent of a parent or guardian. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.

11. Changes to This Privacy Policy: We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in the App, legal requirements, or our data practices. Updated policies will be posted in the App, with the effective date revised. Continued use of the App constitutes acceptance of the updated Policy.

12. Contact Us: For questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, contact us at: support@mymonthly.co
